group_manifest.proof_strategy: Use one group for all seven related obligations. Establish local suffixed helper facts for head exclusion, address segment cuts/joins, and payload insertion. Prove entry by four-case shape decomposition, returns by inverse address-shape reconstruction plus store_dll_compose, and derivations by exact parameter instantiation and wand introduction. Preserve shared DLL.DL_Node and XiziLocalDLL naive_C_Rules layout throughout. Do not reuse guarded legacy predicates or introduce nonnull assumptions.
